Title: A Lovely Day for Litter
Content: Outside my window, it looked cold and gray.
Mom knocked on my door as I hid in bed.
“Good morning! Isn’t it a lovely `text(day)`?
Come with me on my walk today,” she said.
I groaned but got out of bed. When I spied
Mom had gloves and bags to pick up trash,
I groaned again. “Oh, please no, Mom!” I cried.
“Come on!” she said, “We’ll be done in a flash.”
So I put on my coat, trudged out after Mom,
Showing off a trash bag, to my dismay,
Like a fancy purse. She waved to Mr. Ransom:
“Good morning! Isn’t it a lovely `text(day)`?”
Mom tracked down scattered, wet note cards.
She plopped them in the bag and turned to say
To Ari and Jorge playing in their yards:
“Good morning! Isn’t it a lovely `text(day)`?”
I kicked a torn soccer ball with a sad sag
Behind my mom with a thump, thump.
“Great find!” she said, “Let’s put it in the bag.”
Shrugging, I put it in the bag for the dump.
“Good morning! Isn’t it a lovely day?”
Mom said to a lady jogging past.
I ran after a can whooshed by the wind away,
And saw the sun peeking out at last.
I helped Mom untangle some balloon string
From a towering tree in the nearby park.
Like a cheery bird, Mom started to sing
And I hummed along like a little `ultext(lark)`.
We got closer to home with a clink, and swish
Sounding from the trash bag. Mom grinned at me
As I waved hello at our neighbor Mrs. McClish:
“Good morning!” I said, “Isn’t it a lovely day?”
As we threw away the bag of trash, Mom said to me,
“Isn’t it lovely to make our street a nicer place to be?”

:box:`bbtext(Glossary)`

`ultext(lark)`: a type of songbird
